text:
Updated: I was told by a dentist here I needed to replace a crown and it would cost me tens of thousands of baht. I went to another dentist for a second opinion. I was told my crown was fine and no replacement was required. Make sure you check elsewhere before agreeing to an expensive treatment here. Especially during low tourist season.

Original review:
Very expensive teeth cleaning. I've had my teeth cleaned at several dentists in Pattaya for 1000 baht. This place charged me 1400 baht, because the dentist said I hadn't cleaned my teeth for 9 months and more work was required.

My husband was supposed to get his teeth cleaned after me. I cancelled his appointment. We went to another dentist who  charged him 1000 baht. He also hadn't had his teeth cleaned for 9 months.

Not much work was done for my teeth cleaning, despite the 40% increase in cost. It's definitely nothing as thorough as the teeth cleaning you get in a developed country.

I was also told I needed a crown. The dentist told me a price higher by 700 baht. She even argued with me. In the end, she pulled out her calculator and found out I was right. Make sure you check every item on the bill and do the calculations yourself before you make any payments here.

Finally, the dentist speaks poor English, at the level of uneducated bar girls. She also had an appalling lack of respect for me. She talked down to me, like I was a child, when she wanted to explain the costs and procedure of doing a crown for me. She insisted on getting my husband into the room, like I wasn't able to understand her or make my own decisions. If you are a woman with any self-respect, do not come here.
